context: a single passage from a letter by J. D. Hooker, which you are answering on its own
exchanges: I saw Huxley today who talked about giving a R Inst. Friday Evening to your book—but pray say nothing of this—it may come to nothing—he is vastly pleased with it.
It would be unspeakably grand if Huxley were to lecture on the subject, but I can see this is mere chance: Faraday might think it too unorthodox.
